common.description: Chrome shared by every view — the drawer stack, settings, error fallbacks, the report form, map controls, and the post-event feedback banner.

back.description: Peek-strip name for the root drawer, shown when a deeper view is open.

back_to.description: Peek-strip name that names its target view. `%{title}` = the parent view’s title.

close.description: Close control on every drawer, the report modal, the compact dialog, and the feedback banner.

explore.description: Accessible label (aria-label) of the collapsed base drawer’s toggle.

loading.description: Screen-reader label of every loading spinner.

cancel.description: Cancel button, shared by the registration form and the report form.

widget_label.description: Landmark name (role="region") of the widget root, and the compact card’s heading. Must never be blank — it is how a screen-reader user finds the widget.

all_classes_free.description: Subtitle under the Region, Online, and Registration headers.

title.description: Accessible label (aria-label) of the settings cog, and the settings drawer heading.

theme_auto.description: Theme row: follow the operating system’s light/dark setting.

errors.description: Failure copy and the onward links offered beside it. Each key maps to one ERROR_POLICY kind in the widget.

generic.description: Fallback message for an unclassified failure (ERROR_POLICY.unknown).

retry.description: Retry action on an error fallback.

offline.description: Message when the browser reports no network (ERROR_POLICY.offline).

server.description: Message for a 5xx response from the API (ERROR_POLICY.server).

not_found_event.description: Message shown when an event link points at an event that no longer exists.

not_found_region.description: Message shown when a region link points at a place that no longer exists.

config.description: Message when the host page embedded the widget without a usable API key (ERROR_POLICY.config).

unavailable.description: Default reason shown in the registration-blocked row when no more specific reason applies.

share_unavailable.description: Message in the Share view when the event has no shareable URL.

captcha_blocked.description: Message when the host page’s Content-Security-Policy blocked the Turnstile security check.

no_events.description: Empty-list message in the Region and Online views, when the place itself has no events.

back_to_region.description: Onward link back to the containing region. `%{region}` = region name.

near_city.description: Onward link to events near the visitor. `%{city}` = detected city name.

browse_countries.description: Onward link to the country list — the last rung of every error fallback.

search_label.description: Placeholder of the geocoder offered inside an error fallback.

report.description: The report-an-issue form: settings row, modal heading, fields, and its two end states.

title.description: Settings row, error-fallback action, and the report modal’s heading.

description.description: Introductory line under the report modal’s heading.

email_label.description: Label of the optional email field.

email_help.description: Helper text under the email field, explaining it is optional.

email_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the email field — an example address.

submit.description: Submit button of the report form.

sent.description: Thank-you state shown after the report is accepted.

blocked.description: Shown in place of the form when the security check could not load at all.

report_errors.description: Validation messages and server refusals for the report form.

email.description: Validation: the email field holds something that is not an address.

message.description: Validation: the message is too short. `%{min}` = minimum character count.

message_max.description: Validation: the message is too long. `%{max}` = maximum character count.

send_failed.description: Refusal: the security check was unavailable, or the send failed for an unnamed reason.

captcha.description: Refusal: the security check expired and must be redone before sending.

disposable_email.description: Refusal: the email address belongs to a disposable-address provider.

urls_not_allowed.description: Refusal: the message contains links, which are rejected as spam.

map.description: Labels on the map’s own controls.

location_not_available.description: Label of the geolocate control once the browser has refused or failed to supply a location.

feedback.description: The banner shown after a registrant answers the post-event follow-up email, on the Event and Region views.

confirmed_title.description: Banner heading after the registrant confirms the class took place.

confirmed_body.description: Banner body after the registrant confirms the class took place.

denied_title.description: Banner heading after the registrant reports the class could not be found.

denied_body.description: Banner body after the registrant reports the class could not be found.

nearby.description: Banner link to other nearby classes, on the Event and Region views.

below.description: Banner line pointing at the list already on screen, on the Region view.

countries.description: The base view: the list of countries the atlas covers.

title.description: Heading of the base drawer, and the drawer stack’s document title.

search.description: The Search view: the geocoder, the paged result list, and the sort menu.

title.description: Search view heading, and its peek-strip name.

placeholder.description: Placeholder of the geocoder input, in every header that carries one.

results.description: The paged result list under a search.

more.description: Button that reveals the next page of results.

farther.description: Button that widens the search radius beyond the nearby band.

showing.description: Result-count line. `%{shown}` = results rendered, `%{total}` = results found.

no_nearby.description: Message when a search found nothing inside the radius (ERROR_POLICY['no-nearby']). `%{km}` = radius in kilometres.

sort.description: The result sort menu. Each option key is looked up dynamically by its sort id.

recommended.description: Sort option: the default blend of distance and imminence.

soonest.description: Sort option: next to start first.

country_site.description: Shown when a search lands in a country the atlas does not list, and that country runs its own website (ERROR_POLICY['country-site']).

title.description: Message that the country has no listings here yet. `%{country}` = country name.

cta.description: Onward link to that country’s own website. `%{country}` = country name.

nearby_prompt.description: The header prompt offering to jump to the visitor’s own city.

dismiss.description: Control that hides the prompt for this visit.

filters.description: The Filter view: its chrome, and one sub-group per filter control.

chrome.description: The filter drawer’s own heading, actions, and chips.

title.description: Filter view heading, and its peek-strip name.

apply.description: Button that closes the drawer and applies the selection.

clear.description: Action that clears every filter at once.

clear_one.description: Action that clears a single filter section.

remove.description: Accessible label of an active-filter chip’s remove button. `%{label}` = the filter’s own label.

any_time.description: Chip text when no time-of-day filter is set.

no_results.description: Empty-list message when the filters, rather than the place, excluded everything.

label.description: Section label of the format filter.

offline.description: Format option: classes with a physical venue.

cadence.description: Filter: how often a class repeats.

label.description: Section label of the frequency filter.

once.description: Frequency option: a single occasion, not a series.

days.description: Filter: which weekdays a class runs on. The day names themselves come from the browser, not from here.

label.description: Section label of the day-of-week filter.
Section label of the time-of-day filter.

language.description: Filter: the language a class is held in. The language names themselves come from the browser.

label.description: Section label of the language filter.

empty.description: Shown when no class in view declares a language.

dates.description: Filter: a date range, and the chips that summarise it.

label.description: Section label of the date filter.

from.description: Label of the range’s start input.

to.description: Label of the range’s end input.

pill_from.description: Chip for an open-ended range with a start. `%{date}` = start date.

pill_until.description: Chip for an open-ended range with an end. `%{date}` = end date.

pill_range.description: Chip for a closed range. `%{start}` = start date, `%{end}` = end date.

region.description: Filter: narrow the list to one region.

label.description: Section label of the region filter.

search.description: Placeholder of the region search input.

empty.description: Shown when the region search matches nothing.

online.description: The Online view: classes held online, which belong to no place.

title.description: Online view heading, its row on the Countries list, its link on a Region, and its peek-strip name.

event.description: One event: how it is described, the actions offered on it, its schedule, and its auto-generated CMS title.

display.description: Everything that describes an event — the status chip, the when-line, the where-line, distances, the type label, and the registration slot. Shared by the list card, the Event view, and the Calendar entry.

about.description: Section heading above the event description.

free_meditation_class.description: Suffix appended after the event title in the standalone page <title>.

chip_full.description: Status chip: the event has no places left.

chip_today.description: Status chip and when-line: the next session is today.

chip_ended.description: Status chip: the event is over.

chip_starts.description: Status chip for an event that has not begun. `%{date}` = start date.

started_on.description: Status chip and when-line for a series already under way. `%{date}` = start date.

first_session.description: When-line for a course that has not begun. `%{date}` = first session’s date and time.

next_session.description: When-line for a series under way. `%{date}` = next session’s date and time.

event_ended.description: When-line and registration-blocked message for a finished event.

event_full.description: Microcopy and registration-blocked message when the event has no places left.

registration_closed.description: Register-slot label and blocked message when registration has closed.

registration_required.description: Microcopy on a course, saying a place must be booked in advance.

registration_external.description: Refusal shown when registration is handled on another website.

online_joining_note.description: Microcopy on an online class, saying the joining link arrives by email.

contact_to_join_full.description: Helper under a full event, offering the host as a way in.

contact_to_join_late.description: Helper under a series already under way, offering the host as a way in.

contact_for_timing.description: When-line for a listing with no schedule, and the message shown when registration is hidden.

online.description: Where-line badge, and the Calendar entry badge, for an online class.

hosted_from.description: Where-line for an online class, naming the host’s city. `%{city}` = host city.

time_in_place.description: Viewer-local time under the where-line. `%{time}` = local time, `%{city}` = the event’s city.

distance_away.description: List card distance from the visitor. `%{distance}` = formatted distance.

distance_from_place.description: List card distance from a named place. `%{distance}` = formatted distance, `%{place}` = place name.

distance_from_search.description: List card distance from the searched point. `%{distance}` = formatted distance.

type_class.description: Type label: a class with no stated cadence.

type_class_daily.description: Type label: a class held every day.

type_class_weekly.description: Type label: a class held weekly.

type_class_fortnightly.description: Type label: a class held every second week.

type_class_monthly.description: Type label: a class held monthly.

type_course.description: Type label: a limited run of sessions.

sessions_count.description: Session count beside a course’s schedule, entered per plural form. `%{count}` = number of sessions.

see_nearby.description: Register-slot link offered when this event cannot be joined.

register_now.description: Label of the register button in the register slot.

actions.description: The circular action buttons on an event, and the controls inside its image carousel.

contact.description: Action circle that opens the host’s contact details; also the fallback contact label.

directions.description: Action circle that opens directions to the venue.

website.description: Action circle that opens the event’s own website.

share.description: Action circle that opens the Share view.

add_calendar.description: Add-to-calendar action, offered on the registration thank-you screen.

download_ics.description: Add-to-calendar menu item that downloads an .ics file.

view_photo.description: Image carousel: open the photo full size.

pause_slideshow.description: Image carousel: stop it advancing on its own.

recurrence.description: Human-readable schedules. The weekday and list separators come from the browser — only the sentence around them is translated.

daily_n.description: Repeats every few days. `%{interval}` = number of days.

weekly_1.description: Repeats every week on one weekday. `%{weekday}` = localized day name.

weekly_2.description: Repeats every second week. `%{weekday}` = localized day name.

weekly_n.description: Repeats every few weeks. `%{interval}` = number of weeks, `%{weekday}` = localized day name.

weekly_multi.description: Repeats on several weekdays. `%{weekdays}` = a browser-formatted list of day names.

monthly_1st.description: Repeats on the first given weekday of each month. `%{weekday}` = localized day name.

monthly_2nd.description: Repeats on the second given weekday of each month. `%{weekday}` = localized day name.

monthly_3rd.description: Repeats on the third given weekday of each month. `%{weekday}` = localized day name.

monthly_4th.description: Repeats on the fourth given weekday of each month. `%{weekday}` = localized day name.

monthly_last.description: Repeats on the last given weekday of each month. `%{weekday}` = localized day name.

monthly_date.description: Repeats on a fixed day number each month. `%{day}` = day of the month.

title.description: Auto-generated event title, used when a manager leaves an event's title blank — preferred over a hand-written generic name, because it can be improved for every event at once. One complete sentence per time of day (not a shared prefix plus a separate word). `%{place}` = the venue name, or the first comma-segment of the street address. NOTE: the event title is no longer localized (#609) — only the default locale's set below is read, and the Atlas widget translates the composed title client-side.

morning.description: Auto-title for an event starting between 05:00 and 11:59 local time. `%{place}` = venue or street.

afternoon.description: Auto-title for an event starting between 12:00 and 16:59 local time. `%{place}` = venue or street.

evening.description: Auto-title for an event starting between 17:00 and 21:59 local time. `%{place}` = venue or street.

default.description: Auto-title used when the start time is late (22:00–04:59) or the event has no schedule at all. `%{place}` = venue or street.

calendar.description: The Calendar view’s own header. The grid’s dates and day names come from the browser.

title.description: Calendar view heading, and its peek-strip name.

previous.description: Control that steps back one month, week, or page.

next.description: Control that steps forward one month, week, or page.

pick_date.description: Control that opens the date picker.

registration.description: The registration form: its fields, its validation messages, and the optional questions an event may ask.

form.description: Headings, field labels, notices, and buttons in the registration form.

title.description: Registration view heading, and its peek-strip name. Untranslated in every non-English locale today — the English merge serves English until a translator fills it.

show_more_dates.description: Control that reveals further start dates.

submit.description: Submit button of the registration form.

okay.description: Acknowledgement button that dismisses the thank-you screen.

followup.description: Thank-you screen line promising a confirmation email.

invite_friend.description: Thank-you screen line encouraging the registrant to bring someone.

online_notice.description: Notice on an online class, saying the joining link arrives by email.

privacy_policy.description: Consent text beside the submit button.

error_title.description: Heading of the form’s error state.

captcha_retry.description: Refusal: the security check expired and must be redone before registering.

errors.description: Validation messages for the registration form’s three required fields.

email.description: Validation: the email field holds something that is not an address.

name.description: Validation: the name field is empty or incomplete.

starting_at.description: Validation: no starting date was chosen.

questions.description: The optional questions an event may ask a registrant. These keys are exactly EVENT_REGISTRATION_QUESTIONS (src/lib/registrations/questions.ts), in order — a unit spec pins them.

experience.description: Question `experience`: whether the registrant has meditated with Sahaja Yoga before.

referral.description: Question `referral`: how the registrant heard about the event.

aspirations.description: Question `aspirations`: what the registrant hopes to get out of it.

questions.description: Question `questions`: anything the registrant wants to ask beforehand.

share.description: The Share view: the share targets offered for one event.

title.description: Share view heading, and its peek-strip name. Untranslated in every non-English locale today — the English merge serves English until a translator fills it.

share_on.description: Label of one share target. `%{platform}` = the platform’s name.

native.description: Label of the device’s own share sheet.

copy_link.description: Action that copies the event link to the clipboard.

copied.description: Confirmation shown after the link is copied.

compact.description: The compact card, rendered where the host’s box is too small for the interface itself.

open.description: The card’s one button, which opens the atlas.

emails.description: Chrome for emails the CMS sends to registrants. Event data (title, address, times) is never translated — only the surrounding copy is.

confirmation_subject.description: Subject line of the registration confirmation email. `%{event}` = event title.

confirmation_heading.description: Main heading inside the confirmation email, e.g. "You're registered".

confirmation_intro.description: Opening line addressing the registrant. `%{name}` = registrant's name.

when_label.description: Section label above the date/time of the class.

where_label.description: Section label above the address or joining link.

online_cta.description: Call-to-action button label for joining an online class.

online_link_hint.description: Line introducing the plain-text join URL, shown for email clients that strip buttons.

directions_cta.description: Call-to-action button label that opens the venue address in a maps app, for an in-person class.

about_label.description: Section label above the event description ("What to expect").

contact_label.description: Section label above the host's name and phone number.

sessions_count.description: Session count appended to a limited-run course's schedule, entered per plural form. `%{count}` = number of sessions.

footer_reason.description: Footer line explaining why the registrant received this email.

footer_website.description: Footer link label pointing at the client service's website. `%{name}` = service name.

reminder_subject.description: Subject line of the session reminder email (sent 24h before a class). `%{event}` = event title.

reminder_heading.description: Main heading inside the reminder email, e.g. "Your class is tomorrow".

reminder_intro.description: Opening line of the reminder email. `%{name}` = registrant's name.

reminder_footer_reason.description: Footer line explaining why the registrant received the reminder.

followup_subject.description: Subject line of the post-event follow-up email. `%{event}` = event title.

followup_heading.description: Main heading inside the follow-up email. `%{event}` = event title.

followup_intro.description: Opening line of the follow-up email. `%{name}` = registrant, `%{event}` = event title.

followup_ask.description: The confirm/deny question: why the registrant's answer matters for an unverified listing.

followup_confirm_cta.description: Button label confirming the class took place.

followup_deny_cta.description: Button label reporting that the class could not be found.

followup_footer_reason.description: Footer line explaining why the registrant received the follow-up.

unsubscribe_cta.description: Footer link label in the reminder email that opens the unsubscribe page.

unsubscribe_heading.description: Heading on the unsubscribe landing page.

unsubscribe_intro.description: Prompt on the unsubscribe page confirming what stops. `%{event}` = event title.

unsubscribe_confirm_cta.description: Button label that confirms unsubscribing from reminders.

unsubscribe_working.description: Button label shown while the unsubscribe request is in flight.

unsubscribe_done_title.description: Title of the success card after unsubscribing.

unsubscribe_done_message.description: Body of the success card after unsubscribing.

unsubscribe_error_title.description: Title of the error card when unsubscribing fails.

unsubscribe_error_message.description: Body of the error card when unsubscribing fails.
